body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Norwich, United Kingdom. It starts at Marine Parade.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> There's so much to discover at SEA LIFE Great Yarmouth! Your ticket will get you closer than ever before to over 1,500 creatures in 10 different zones!
>
> Come face-to-fin with Black Tip Reef Sharks and meet 'Noah' the Green Sea Turtle inside SEA LIFE Great Yarmouth's huge Ocean Tropical display and underwater tunnel.
>
> You'll also meet playful Humboldt Penguins, as they swim and waddle together. Make sure to immerse yourself in the mysterious and graceful world of Rays in Under the Raydar!
>
> You can even find out how it feels to touch a starfish at the new Rock Pool Explorer experience and discover the world's smallest crocodiles in the African Dwarf Crocodile enclosure!
>
> With special events throughout the year and an adventure quiz, there's plenty for everyone to enjoy at SEA LIFE Great Yarmouth!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €27.42. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 47 ratings and 36 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
